title: Gift shop renovating the storefront facade of a leased unit — Mayagüez, coastal zone (zone X)
description: I am opening a gift shop in a leased storefront near the Mayagüez malecón. We will renovate the outside: new facade, a new awning and new windows facing the street. Two employees.

mustInclude.rationale: RULE_0002 municipality baseline: every business gets the IRS EIN; employees also trigger RULE_0620.
RULE_0003 municipality baseline: Registro de Comerciante (SURI).
RULE_0004 municipality baseline: Patente Municipal (Ley 107-2020 Codigo Municipal).
RULE_0007: a physical commercial premises -> Permiso Unico (Ley 161-2009).
RULE_0643/0644: renovation project type -> OGPe construction permit (Ley 161-2009).

Exterior work at a pin inside the coastal zone: RULE_0708 matches on the exterior_work basis, so the interior-only downgrade (REG-INTERIOR-COASTAL-001) must not apply. RULE_0708 is itself a heuristic (EXPERT VALIDATION NEEDED; 15 CFR 930.57, 16 U.S.C. 1456(c)(3)(A)).

mustNotInclude.rationale: FEMA zone X: RULE_0706/0707 need location.flood_zone.sfha / floodway.
Commercial use on urban tourism-commercial land, no change of use: RULE_0709-0712 cannot fire.

ordering.rationale: KB documents.json: DOC_PATENTE_MUNICIPAL depends on DOC_PERMISO_UNICO.

notes: Added 2026-10-05 by the scenario loop: first gift-shop scenario, and the exterior-work companion to KG10 (the coastal review stays required when work is outside).
